text: Committed web bundle is not reproducible from HEAD and the lockfile; pin Node or verify it

Not a defect. Built web/ at the 1.16.0 release commit 7f49573 in a temp worktree on Node 20.19.2 / npm 9.2.0 with the same lockfile: index-C_OcqfYB.js, index-BZd3rlwO.css and index.html came out byte-identical (cmp) to the committed bundle. The ~3.4 KB difference at HEAD is from T-191/T-192/T-193 changing web/src after that release, which is expected between releases: release.sh rebuilds at release time and build-wheel.sh deliberately packages the committed bundle. README.md and web/README.md already say the committed bundle only picks up source changes when rebuilt and committed, so no doc change either.
